scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
^ff0000If you attempt to tame any monsters, it will not count as a kill. Please be careful.^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
^ff0000请注意，驯服魔物不计入击杀数。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Your base level is too low, come back when you hit level 60+.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
您的基础等级太低了，请达到60级后再来。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Oh, a curious onlooker? I'm Marry Jae, the person in charge of weekends among the days of the week.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
哦，来凑热闹的吗？我是玛丽·杰，一周七天里，周末归我管。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
What is the weekend dungeon? Actually, it's a specially designed space for new adventurers to train.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
周末副本是什么？其实就是专为新手冒险者设计的训练场。

scripts.text: ^0000FFLooking around, it's obvious that Marry Jae is talking to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF环顾四周，很明显玛丽·杰正在和你说话。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
For those who do not have a party on the weekends, this place is hunting and experience gaining grounds for lonely adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
周末找不到队友？这里就是为孤身冒险者准备的狩猎练级场所！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Besides, the experience gain here is very generous.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
而且，这里的经验值十分丰厚。

scripts.text: When is the opening time?
scripts.translation: 开放时间是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The dungeon will be open during:
^0000FFSaturday 00:00 ~ Sunday 23:59^000000

[Marry Jae]
I hope to see you when the weekend arrives~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
期待周末与您相见~

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You need to form a party of one member or more.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
请先组建一支至少1人的队伍。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Sorry, but the entry period to the Weekend Dungeon has expired.
Take a rest while waiting for the dungeon to be available again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
抱歉，周末副本的入场时间已结束。
请稍作休息，等待副本再次开放。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The cooldown has expired.
You may re-enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
冷却结束，可以再次进入记忆副本了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
I think you're just about ready.
Now, would you like to enter it now?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
我想您已经准备好了。
那么，您现在要进入吗？

scripts.text: Enter Weekend Dungeon
scripts.translation: 进入周末副本

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Prepare Memorial Dungeon
scripts.translation: 准备记忆副本

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The Memorial Dungeon has been created.
You may now enter.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
记忆副本已创建，现在可以进入了。

scripts.text: There is no Memorial Dungeon registered.
scripts.translation: 尚未登记记忆副本。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You have not prepared?
Can't really help it I guess.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
您还没有准备好吗？
那我也没办法了。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
I offer packaging services for those who wish to present a precious gift to a cherished one.
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
想给珍视的人送一份好礼？我这里提供礼品包装服务。

[Gift Supplies Clerk]
If you have 5 units of <ITEM>{0}<INFO>23143</INFO></ITEM> or <ITEM>{1}<INFO>23142</INFO></ITEM>, I can pack it for just ^FF000060000^000000 Zeny!
Do you want to pack it right now?
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
带来5个<ITEM>{0}<INFO>23143</INFO></ITEM>或<ITEM>{1}<INFO>23142</INFO></ITEM>，再付^FF000060000^000000 Zeny，就能帮您包装！
